reviews.text:
Avoid this place completely - the owner is unprofessional and careless.  The 1st few times were okay, then recently she missed knots, cut was messy and uneven, no bows this time and far from full service.

She sent my dog home with someone else's collar. I had to come back to fix the cut and return the collar.

When I mentioned the level service and attention to l detail has slipped, she got aggressive and responded with name calling and suggested I go elsewhere - which is exactly what I recommend here in this review.

We initially loved Sunny Side Pup. Nothing wrong with their grooming services. BUT....we had an appointment booked for this morning that was cancelled without notification. Our dog does not enjoy grooming. We give him prescription medication to make it easier for him and the groomer. My husband arrives and is told the groomer is not coming in today. No effort to make amends. We gave our dog medication that dopes him up and made the drive to this groomer for absolutely nothing. Terrible customer service.
Been coming here for a while :) always have a great experience, one of my chi chis is very aggressive getting his nails done lol but they handle him with love and care :)

I rarely leave negative reviews, but what happened in this case was serious enough that I feel it needs to be shared.
I have been bringing my dog to this salon for quite some time and had never had a problem before. What happened at his most recent appointment was completely unacceptable.

He had three injured and bleeding paws after his grooming. I was not even told about the injuries until I specifically asked how his appointment had gone. I was told that he had been uncooperative and that there was no one available to help. And that it's ok as it happens all the time.. It's not ok, if they could not safely trim his nails, they should have stopped. Not go on to injure him on 3 paws.

His haircut was also horrendous—his face and legs were noticeably uneven, and he was left with a random bald spot on his chest.

When I called the salon after seeing the extent of what had been done, the lady groomer became defensive and started yelling at me defensively on the phone. Instead of showing concern that he had been injured in their care, I was met with hostility and excuses.

Refunding the charge does not undo what happened. Nico is now in pain and repeatedly licking his injured paws.

After being a loyal customer, I am appalled by what happened to my dog and by the way I was treated when I raised it. A grooming salon should put an animal’s safety first, and when something goes wrong, the very least a customer should expect is honesty, accountability and professionalism. I will never bring my dog back here again.
The staff were very kind and made it easy to leave my cat in their care to have her teeth cleaned.

Called and was told $70 for a full cut with nail trimming and bath. It was never said it was a quote.  Upon pick up I was told it was $85.

When I asked what made the difference, I couldn’t really get a straight answer.
Some of the answers I got were:
“70 is for like a yorkie”. Well my dog is an 8lb yorkie poodle mix
“70 is for a bath and dry”
“…it’s hard to explain”. This is not an answer
“It took longer to dry her than I expected”. She’s shaved down real look. Everyone see for yourself.
Husband saying something about forgetting about the price increase and that in the end she (wife) calls the shots.

I was assured she’d be in a crate but she was running free. She’s ok which is the most important but I would have preferred if they had kept their word.

They can run their business however they want but I just wanted to lay down some facts about my experience.
I happily paid the 85 plus tax and gave a $10 tip.  They kept my dog an extra 2 hrs while I did school pickup up which was incredibly helpful. My dog is safe and is groomed. I was able to get everyone home before dinner. I’m happy.

They’re nice people and i always try to support a local business.

I'm not sure why there are less than stellar reviews for Sunnyside Pup. I think they do any excellent job with our Collie Milo. They have always shown a very professional and caring attitude with us. Milo may sometimes not be in the mood for a grooming, but they have always made it very easy and convenient to work around his moods.They are always very clear on what they will be doing and have never overcharged, in fact, I was told by the owner that it's ok not to tip - if the owner does the grooming....you NEVER hear that! Please support local business...you will not be dissapointed! 🐶 😀👍🏻

DISCLAIMER ‼️ Would not recommend ‼️

They are severely lacking in integrity as a business. I took my 1 year old dog to get a full grooming done and came back home to see him bleeding from his nails. We realized this because he was leaving blood along with his paw prints when walking around our house. This was followed by several days of discomfort during walks. I did not expect this from professionals.

The owner/groomer did not have the courtesy of even letting us know so that we can take the proper precautions, let alone apologizing. This was a huge shock to us because after 9 months of grooming appointments this is the first time that has occurred. The fact that they didn’t even let us know, tells me what kind of business these people are running. This is not a rare occurrence for them.

Save your dog the pain and take them somewhere else.

We’ve been bringing our dog to Sunnyside for 5 years - even followed them from their old location! Allie is always so friendly and welcoming to our dog who can be quite anxious. We won’t go anywhere else and would recommend them highly!

VERY RUDE.... Brought my goldendoodle to get groomed she saved my dog right down to the skin where there  was irration all around his legs. Poor customer service she was yelling at me when she was wrong... Will never take my dog here again.
I have been bringing my Toy Poodle 6 years old now, to Sunnyside for about a year and we have always had a great experience. My pup always looks great after a grooming session and he is always happy.

What an amazing experience! I have a very anxious dog and haven't had much success at other groomers, but Sunnyside pup exceeded my expectations! The Space was open and  very transparent, which I loved:) I also love that it's one consistent groomer, so my dog can get used to her and feel safe🥰 This is going to be my groomer for as long as I have a dog!!!! 💯🫶🥰

Thank you so much April for your kind words! It's always a pleasure to see you both and we love to get Beanz all cleaned up and he's always fantastic for us! Thank you for your recommendation! It's bringing smiles to our faces as we head into the holidays. Looking forward to seeing you in the New Year!

I highly recommend Sunny Side Pup! They’ve been grooming and trimming my dogs nails since opening and are always so kind and go above and beyond to accommodate you and your fur babies needs! Picture of the happy clients 💜🥰 …

I’ve been coming for nail trims for my dog for the past year or two and they’re always extremely nice and professional. Today I went for grooming and the service was exceptional, they also have him a little bow which was the cherry on top for the experience. Love them and love the place so much ❤️
Friendly staff, clean nice salon, friendly pups inside , my dogs look amazing and for an amazing price thank you will be back & will recommend

We've used Sunny Side Pup for grooming twice for our 1 yr old Cockapoo and could not be happier! I used other groomers with our previous dog and this is actually the best.
They seem to be kind and Stella doesn't come home as if she's traumatized by the experience.  😉

Amazing work with Rio.
Merci
Accommodating, friendly, great with our pups, professional... Thanks for being so great! -  Mr T and C ❤️
Friendly and welcoming environment.   My little guy even got a tie
Fantastic groomers! My pup comes back looking wonderful everytime :) 5 stars! Thanks ladies.
Online booking with clear prices, friendly staff, and our little guy looks great in his new bowtie
Best groomers in the city. They take excellent care of my dog and it makes me feel comfortable knowing she's in good hands. Her haircuts always look awesome. Definitely recommended them

Elliott and I had such an amazing experience at Sunny Side Pup!  Elliott finds grooming to be very stressful but the staff were so welcoming and friendly from the minute we walked in that he quickly relaxed. I don’t think I have seen him so chill after a session. Thank you Genevieve!
So happy to find this gem of a place in the neighbourhood. Going rates, lovely staff, organized, and my dogs like going there after having a tragic grooming experience elsewhere. Win!
Jen did an amazing job with my 10-month-old mini golden doodle. It was her first professional grooming and my dog was a bit nervous, but she came out totally happy. I definitely recommend Jen!

This is the ONLY grooming place I will take my doggo Pearl! Pearl is extremely nervous and anxious but Allie and Alex take the best care of her! She always looks (and smells) amazing after her grooming appointment! Whenever I'm out for a walk after Pearl's freshly groomed hair other dog owners will ask where she got her hair done and I always tell them go to Sunnyside Pup! Thanks for taking the best care of Pearl!

The owners were incredibly prompt responding to my inquiry about their availability for a dog nail cutting. They were able to schedule us in the same day, in the afternoon.  The building was easy to locate and accessible. My boy was nervous and the groomer handled him with love and provided endless treats. The pricing was affordable and the whole process was done in 2 mins. Our appointment was at 1245 and we were walking away at 1248.
Expensive food. But dog likes it and the people are decent.
Super impressed with their patience and care. Couldn’t be happier with the service and very impressed with how well they treated my dog. Highly recommend
